name: Pueblo Puzzling 2022

venue.name: [Pueblo Convention Center](http://www.puebloconventioncenter.com/)
venue.details: Competition is being held in Fortino Grand Ballroom A

information: ## Outside food and beverage is not permitted. Speedcubing is returning to Pueblo for the first time in 4 years! All competitors should read the **Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety** tab before registering There is no mask policy at the venue, but we still encourage anyone that wishes to wear one to do so. If the situation regarding COVID-19 worsens, masks may become a requirement closer to the competition. The competitor limit for this competition is 105 competitors. We are asking competitors to bring a maximum of two guests.
